aniraku.description:
Aniraku is a production-grade FOSS native Android anime streaming client inspired by Nothing OS. Featuring monochrome aesthetics, dot-matrix labels, direct-to-proxy HLS recovery, a 45-second forward buffer, manual 1080p/720p/480p quality selection, and seamless AniList/Supabase synchronization.
Included in the store description and GitHub README, noting that backend services run on free instances and welcoming donations to upgrade server capacity.
